losses.message: the extended entity base stores an integer in 85 record(s), and a body record stores one more in 1; the source states neither, and the decoder drops them

streams without a decoder: DESIGN_PARAMETER_DATA, AUTOGRAPH_DATA, PROP_DATA, VERSION, STEP_DATA, HOLE_OPERATIONS_DATA, CUSTOM_ITEM_PROP_DATA, GLOBAL_PARAMETER_DATA_CACHE, STANDARD_DESIGN_PROP_DATA, LIGHT_CONFIGURATION_DATA, EXTERNAL_THREAD_OPERATIONS_DATA

the SAB_DATA stream declares save format 33.0, which no verified Spatial ACIS band declares; its records were read with the grammar `acis:save-format-217` declares, and what they decoded is reported as it decoded
